msContents.summary: Colection of alchemical tracts, receipts, etc., including extracts from Paracelsus. In German and Latin. Written by the same hand throughout in a neat German script. On off. 30v, 32, 72, 80 are small pen drawings of alchemical apparatus. Produced in Argona. [li]Hollandus (J. I.). De lapide philosophorum. Ff. 1-18 in German. Fol. 1 De lapide Philosophorum Autore Isaaco Holando [sic] Argone. 1567. mense Aprili.[/li][li]Theophrastus (wilhelmus). Zwey particularia. Ff. 18v-20 in German. Fol. 18v Anno 1567 6 Junii. Zwey Particularia Wilhelmi Theophrasti so er seinem Sun [ge]gen Salzburg geschickt hat ausz seiner aignen hand-schrifft.[/li][li]Bernhardus Trevisanus. Processus lapidis philosophici. Ff. 22-46 in German. Fol. 22 Processus lapidis philosophici particularis et uniuersalis ex Mercurio corporis scilicet Solis aut Lune procedens cum Practica Bernhardl Comitis Taruisini maxime Conueniens. Anno 1566.[/li][li]Miscellaneous alchemical processes and receipts. Ff. 48-95 in German. Fol. 50 Ex Autographo Theophrasti rium ex sine omni alio facere: probatum per Hanz Theamer. 51 De secretum Secretorum theo. Paracelsi. 54 [Anon.] Processus uff den Mercurium In gut fein 76 Sequuntur Chymica Theophrasti Paracelsi. Item alia quaedam. 76v Cementum perimum Theophrasti ex. 78 Cementum quintum Theophrasti P[aracelsi]. 90v [Anon.] Vermerckt hie die recht wahr Kunst zu machen den rechten waren lapidem Philosophorum vorinn Aurum potabile der waren Ertzney und auch der metallenn.[/li][li]Encelius (C.). De re metallica. (Incomplete). Ff. 96-end De re metallica [sic] hoc est de origine, varietate, et natura corporum metallicorum, lapidum, gemmarum atque aliarum que ex fodinis eruuntur rerum ad Medicinae usum deseruientium. Libri III. Autore Christophoro Encelio Salueldensi. Cum priuilegio Imperiali. The transcript ends at Book II, cap. 2 'De chalcitide', and is made from a copy of Egenolph's Frankfort edition. Of this there is an undated issue-probably 1551, and a dated one of 1557. [Cf. Ferguson 'Bibliotheca Chemica, Vol. I, p. 240.].[/li]
